why: Enables incremental, streaming collection of benchmark results during evaluation for real-time monitoring and persistence.
what: Writes a dictionary as JSON to a file handle, appends a newline, and flushes the buffer to ensure immediate persistence.
how: Uses json.dump() with str converter for non-serializable values and calls flush() to force immediate disk write.

inputs.name: handle
inputs.constraints: Must support write() and flush() methods; typically an open file object

inputs.name: result
inputs.constraints: Dictionary with JSON-serializable or stringifiable values

outputs.meaning: No return value; side effect writes result to file

throws: TypeError if result contains non-serializable objects
IOError if file handle is invalid or closed
